name: DeepMMSearchVQA
description: A novel multimodal VQA dataset created to train and evaluate multimodal LLMs capable of performing on-demand, multi-turn web searches integrating textual and visual information for knowledge-intensive queries.
reputation: A recent multimodal VQA dataset with emerging interest for web-grounded, multi-turn reasoning, but not yet a widely established benchmark.
notes: Dataset created via automated pipeline with real-world web search information; supports training of multimodal LLMs for dynamic web search tasks.
